data_policy.archive_source: immutable pre-v2 Oct18 backup, opened query-only; never initialize source or production
data_policy.current_downloads: descriptive price data only, actual receipt times preserved, separate from replay database; never manufacture past availability
data_policy.hard_cutoff: filter every copied observation/retrieval/label availability before 2026-09-26 UTC; retain earlier fee schedules
data_policy.public_venue_probe: at most one predetermined April7 2025 historical market per outcome-independent API ordering plus one-hour candles; availability evidence only, no evaluation population chosen from probe
data_policy.source_fingerprints: canonical hashes/counts of selected original rows, schema and exact extraction predicates; no legacy forward-ledger synthesis
data_policy.subset: new database initialized before verbatim row import; select universe by series, close date and metadata availability, never by outcome/edge/recommendation; preserve all eligible revisions and original timestamps

execution: Existing candle-based adverse-price replay, 10% volume participation, whole contracts. This is not historical order-book depth, queue priority or actual fills. No new fee/latency implementation; if no forecast survives base availability gates, stress economics are unidentifiable and are not fabricated.

model.features: existing point-in-time-complete-windows-v2; 60s decision spot; 30d hourly realized volatility; admissible matching-interval DVOL else realized; distinct recipes never silently pooled

purpose: Availability-gated retrospective evaluation of BTC downturn and high-volatility conditions; no unseen-event or deployment-approval claim.

regime.descriptive_grid: 00:00 UTC daily; all dates Jan1 2025 through Sep25 2026, no cherry-picked stress days
regime.realized_estimator: sample standard deviation of 720 hourly log returns, annualized by sqrt(365*24), requiring 721 consecutive hourly closes
regime.replay_regime: same trailing formula evaluated at actual decision time using admissible historical inputs; unavailable stays unknown

scope.excluded: touch/barrier, ambiguous contract semantics, all input or label availability at/after hard cutoff

scores.common_population: resolved forecasts with all compared arms; group by model and recipe; probability evidence includes WATCH
scores.event_weighting: average within venue event then equal weight across events; repeated contracts/decisions do not increase independent count
metrics: log loss with fixed identical clipping
settlement-time cumulative net-P&L drawdown; not mark-to-market
scores.native_backtest_baseline: existing backtest market_probability_yes is retained and explicitly labelled; not misrepresented as YES ask
scores.no_observations: null probabilities/returns/drawdown, not zero-risk or proof of no edge
scores.regime_metrics: descriptive only; no inferential subgroup claims or threshold search

stop_rule: If the bounded preserved source yields no admissible forecasts, finish an insufficient-evidence report with full coverage funnel, native replay result, descriptive regime coverage and concrete missing inputs. Do not loosen timing or calibration to force a result.
trial_record: First item8 protocol. Repository protocols and source schema/time extents inspected before freeze; no item8 outcome or profitability query executed. Earlier legacy alert results were already discussed with the user and are not untouched evidence.

walk_forward.cap_policy: abort rather than silently truncate if selected events exceed cap
walk_forward.partial_final_fold: label separately and exclude from qualifying-fold counts

windows.protected_phase1_holdout: 2026-09-27/2026-11-26; no extraction, labels, fitting or scoring
